function armFrame(V, C?): void

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/frame/shared.ts:46

Stores the real Vector3 (+ optional Color) constructors — bootstrap calls this after the lazy three import so the frame modules never import three itself. The Color pair pre-builds the glaciation tint ramp so the per-frame cycle lerps without allocating.

Parameters

V

Vec3Ctor

The three.js Vector3 class.

C?

ColorCtor

The three.js Color class (optional — tests may omit it).
